lines.text: You are on the train home, and your head fills with ideas about tomorrow.
You think of three things your agents should do tomorrow, and each one is a good one.
But your hands are full of bag, and a laptop is the last thing you want to open here.
By tomorrow morning, two of the three have faded, and the third has changed shape.
In Agent R Q, you tap the mic and simply talk, the way you would to a colleague.
On a phone, it uses your phone's own dictation, so it works with the keyboard you already have.
You say all three in one go, at your own pace, with the train rattling in the background.
The words become clear text in the message box, ready for you to read and send.
Ten seconds later, three clear tasks are waiting for your agents, each with its own title.
Your agents pick them up while you ride, and each one starts on its own task.
By the time you get home, they are already moving, and the evening is yours.
Where do your best ideas hit you? Tell us in the comments, and try the mic at Agent R Q dot com.
